matthew: Genealogy from Abraham. Birth. Joseph’s dream. Magi. Egypt. A voice in Ramah.
John in the wilderness. Jesus baptised. A voice from heaven. Tempted in the desert. First disciples.
The Sermon on the Mount begins: beatitudes, salt, light, the law fulfilled.
The Sermon: anger, lust, divorce, oaths, eye for eye, love for enemies.
The Sermon: alms, prayer, fasting. Our Father. Treasure in heaven.
The Sermon: the lamp of the body, two masters, do not be anxious.
The Sermon ends: judge not, ask, the narrow gate, false prophets, two builders.
A leper, a centurion’s servant, a storm stilled, two demoniacs, pigs into the sea.
A paralytic, Matthew’s table, new wine, a girl raised, two blind men. The harvest is plentiful.
Twelve sent. Sheep among wolves. Do not fear those who kill the body.
John’s question from prison. Woes on unrepentant towns. Come to me, all who labour.
Sabbath grain, a withered hand, the sign of Jonah, a divided house, his mother and brothers.
Parables of the kingdom: sower, weeds, mustard, leaven, treasure, pearl, net.
John beheaded. Five thousand fed. Walking on the sea. Touch the fringe of his garment.
Tradition versus commandment. A Canaanite woman. Four thousand fed. The leaven of the Pharisees.
Peter’s confession. The cross announced. Get behind me, Satan. Take up your cross.
Transfiguration. A boy the disciples could not heal. The temple tax in a fish’s mouth.
Who is greatest. The lost sheep. If your brother sins. Forgive seventy times seven.
Divorce, children, a rich young man. The camel and the needle. The last will be first.
Labourers in the vineyard. The request of James and John. Two blind men at Jericho.
The donkey, the temple cleansed, a fig tree, two sons, wicked tenants, a wedding feast begun.
Taxes to Caesar. Resurrection questioned. The great commandment. David’s son and Lord.
Woes on scribes and Pharisees. Jerusalem, Jerusalem. Your house is left desolate.
The Olivet discourse: the temple’s stones, birth pains, the coming of the Son of Man.
Ten virgins, talents, sheep and goats. What you did to the least of these.
Plot, anointing at Bethany, the last supper, Gethsemane, arrest, Peter’s denial.
Judas, Pilate, Barabbas, the cross, darkness, the curtain, burial, a guarded tomb.
The empty tomb. Some doubt. All authority. Make disciples of all nations. I am with you always.
mark: The beginning of the gospel. John, baptism, wilderness, first disciples, a synagogue, a leper.
A paralytic through the roof. Levi’s table. Fasting. The sabbath for humankind.
A withered hand. The Twelve named. Beelzebul. Whoever does the will of God is my family.
The sower. A lamp. Mustard seed. A storm: why are you afraid? Have you still no faith?
A legion in the tombs. A girl of twelve, a woman twelve years ill. Talitha cumi.
Nazareth’s unbelief. Twelve sent. John’s head on a platter. Five thousand. Walking on the sea.
Tradition of the elders. A Syrophoenician woman. Ephphatha. Four thousand. One loaf in the boat.
A blind man in stages. Peter’s confession. The cross. The transfiguration. A deaf-mute spirit.
Who is greatest. A millstone. Salted with fire. Divorce. A rich man. Bartimaeus.
The donkey, the temple, a fig tree withered. The vineyard tenants. Render to Caesar.
A poor widow’s two coins. The temple’s stones. Keep awake.
Anointing at Bethany. The supper. Gethsemane. Arrest. Peter warms himself, and denies.
The council, Pilate, mockery, Golgotha, darkness, a loud cry, a centurion: truly this man was the Son of God.
Burial. A stone. Very early on the first day, the women. He has risen. They said nothing to anyone, for they were afraid.
A later ending in some manuscripts: appearances, a charge, taken up. The earliest copies stop at fear.
The last verses as printed in WEB: go into all the world. The Lord working with them.
luke: A dedicated account for Theophilus. Gabriel to Zechariah. Gabriel to Mary. The Magnificat.
Birth in Bethlehem. Shepherds. Simeon and Anna. A boy in the temple: I must be in my Father’s house.
John’s preaching. Jesus baptised. A genealogy back to Adam, son of God.
Temptation. Nazareth’s synagogue: today this scripture is fulfilled. Capernaum. A catch of fish.
A leper, a paralytic, Levi, new wine. The Son of Man is lord of the sabbath.
Twelve named. The plain: beatitudes and woes. Love your enemies. A tree and its fruit.
A centurion’s faith. A widow’s son at Nain. John’s question. A woman who anoints his feet.
The sower. A lamp. His mother and brothers. A storm. A legion. A girl raised.
Twelve sent. Five thousand. Peter’s confession. Transfiguration. A boy at the foot of the mountain.
Who is greatest. A Samaritan village. Foxes have holes. The seventy sent. The good Samaritan. Mary and Martha.
The Lord’s prayer. A strong man. Jonah’s sign. Woes on lawyers. A dinner that turns sharp.
Leaven of the Pharisees. Do not be anxious. A rich fool. Be ready. Fire on the earth.
Repent or perish. A fig tree given one more year. A bent woman. The narrow door. Jerusalem, Jerusalem.
A sabbath meal. The lowest place. A great banquet. Count the cost. Salt.
A lost sheep, a lost coin, a lost son. The father running.
A dishonest manager. Rich man and Lazarus. What is exalted among humans is an abomination to God.
Stumbling blocks. Ten lepers. The kingdom among you. A widow and a judge. A Pharisee and a tax collector.
Children. A rich ruler. A blind man at Jericho. Zacchaeus. The parable of the minas.
The donkey, weeping over the city, the temple cleansed. By what authority.
Wicked tenants. Taxes. Resurrection. David’s son. A widow’s offering.
The temple’s fate. Jerusalem surrounded. The Son of Man coming. Stay awake.
The supper, Gethsemane, arrest, Peter’s denial, a look, a cock.
Herod and Pilate. Barabbas. The cross. A thief: remember me. Into your hands I commit my spirit.
The tomb. Emmaus. Fish and honeycomb. The Scriptures opened. Stay in the city until you are clothed with power.
john: In the beginning was the Word. The Word became flesh. John points: the Lamb of God. First disciples.
A wedding at Cana. Water to wine. The temple cleansed. Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it.
Nicodemus at night. Born from above. God so loved the world. John must decrease.
A woman at a well in Samaria. Living water. My food is to do the will of him who sent me.
Bethesda. A man thirty-eight years ill. The Son does what he sees the Father doing.
Five thousand. I am the bread of life. A hard saying. Will you also go away?
The feast of booths. Living water. Division. No one laid hands on him, because his hour had not come.
A woman caught in adultery in some manuscripts. I am the light of the world. Before Abraham was, I am.
A man born blind. Who sinned? I was blind, now I see. A shepherd’s work, not a committee’s.
The good shepherd. I and the Father are one. They pick up stones again.
Lazarus. I am the resurrection and the life. A tomb, a loud voice, a man in grave-clothes.
Anointing at Bethany. The hour has come. A voice from heaven. The light, a little longer.
The supper. Feet washed. A new commandment. Peter: you will deny me three times.
The way, the truth, and the life. Another Helper. Peace I leave with you.
I am the vine. Abide. The world will hate you. When the Spirit comes, he will bear witness.
A little while. Grief turned to joy. Take heart: I have overcome the world.
The high-priestly prayer: glory, keeping, oneness, that the world may believe.
The garden, the arrest, the trial. My kingdom is not of this world. What is truth?
Crucifixion. Woman, behold your son. It is finished. Blood and water. A tomb in a garden.
The first day. Mary. Peace be with you. Receive the Holy Spirit. Thomas: my Lord and my God.
A charcoal fire. Do you love me? Feed my sheep. Follow me. The world itself could not contain the books.
acts: The first book, Theophilus. Taken up. A replacement for Judas. Matthias.
Pentecost. Tongues. Peter’s sermon. This Jesus, whom you crucified. Three thousand.
A lame man at the Beautiful Gate. Silver and gold have I none. Abraham’s God has glorified his servant Jesus.
Peter and John arrested. The name. The company prays. They were all filled again.
Ananias and Sapphira. Signs. A prison opened. We must obey God rather than men.
Seven chosen. Stephen, full of grace and power. False witnesses.
Stephen’s speech: from Abraham to the temple. You always resist the Holy Spirit. He falls asleep.
Persecution. Philip in Samaria. Simon the magician. An Ethiopian, Isaiah 53, water beside the road.
Saul on the Damascus road. Scales. Aeneas, Tabitha. The church at peace, being built up.
Cornelius. A sheet from heaven. What God has made clean. The Spirit on Gentiles. Peter has to explain.
Peter reports. Barnabas and Saul at Antioch. Agabus. Relief to Judea.
James killed. Peter imprisoned, then a gate that opens by itself. Herod eaten by worms.
Barnabas and Saul sent. Cyprus. Elymas. Pisidian Antioch: the word to the Gentiles.
Iconium, Lystra, a man lame from birth, stones. Derbe. Elders appointed. The door of faith.
The council at Jerusalem. No greater burden. Circumcision not required. James’s judgment.
Timothy. The Macedonian vision. Lydia. A prison at midnight. The jailer’s household.
Thessalonica, Berea, Athens. An unknown god. Some mocked, some believed.
Corinth. Tentmaking. A vision: I have many people in this city. Gallio. Ephesus begun.
Disciples who knew only John’s baptism. Two years in the hall of Tyrannus. Artemis rioting.
Macedonia and Greece. Eutychus. Miletus: I did not shrink from declaring the whole counsel. Watch the flock.
Tyre, Caesarea, Agabus and a belt. I am ready to be imprisoned. Jerusalem.
A riot in the temple. Paul’s defence in Hebrew. I persecuted this Way.
The council divided. A plot. A nephew. Sent to Felix under guard.
Felix, a more convenient time. Two years. Festus. I appeal to Caesar.
Agrippa. Almost you persuade me. This man could have been set free if he had not appealed.
The voyage. A northeaster. You will stand before Caesar. The ship breaks; all are saved.
Malta. A viper. Publius’s father. Three months. Toward Rome.
Rome. Paul in his own rented quarters, two years, unhindered, preaching the kingdom.
romans: Paul, a servant. The gospel of God. I am not ashamed. The wrath of God revealed against all ungodliness.
Jews and the law. A hearer is not a doer. God shows no partiality.
All under sin. None righteous. Justified by his grace as a gift, through faith in his blood.
Abraham believed. Circumcision as seal, not cause. Grace to the one who does not work but trusts.
Peace with God. Adam and Christ. Where sin increased, grace abounded all the more.
Baptised into death. Dead to sin, alive to God. Sin will have no dominion.
An analogy of marriage. The law and the flesh. Wretched man that I am. Thanks be to God.
No condemnation. The Spirit. Abba. All things work together. Nothing can separate us.
Paul’s grief for Israel. God’s purpose in election. Not all who are descended from Israel belong to Israel.
Zeal without knowledge. Christ the end of the law. How will they hear without a preacher?
Has God rejected his people? A remnant. A wild olive grafted. All Israel will be saved — a mystery.
Mercies of God. A living sacrifice. One body. Love, civic duty, the hour to wake.
The governing authorities. Love is the fulfilling of the law. Put on the Lord Jesus Christ.
The weak and the strong. Do not pass judgment on your brother. Each will give an account.
Please your neighbour. Christ the servant of Jew and Gentile. Paul’s plans for Spain, via Rome.
Phoebe. Prisca and Aquila. A long list of names. A warning. The God of peace will crush Satan. Grace.
1corinthians: To the church of God in Corinth. I appeal: no divisions. The cross is folly to those who are perishing.
I decided to know nothing among you except Christ crucified. The Spirit searches the depths of God.
You are God’s field, God’s building. No other foundation. You are God’s temple.
Stewards of mysteries. Fools for Christ’s sake. I became your father in the gospel.
A man with his father’s wife. Purge the old leaven. Christ our Passover.
Lawsuits among believers. The body is not for sexual immorality. You were bought with a price.
Marriage, the unmarried, the present distress. Remain as you are, if you can.
Food offered to idols. Knowledge puffs up; love builds up. For us there is one God.
Paul’s rights as an apostle, unused. Woe to me if I do not preach. All things to all people.
The rock that followed. Flee idolatry. The cup and the bread. Do all to the glory of God.
Head coverings. The Lord’s supper: not the Lord’s when you despise the church of God.
Spiritual gifts. One body, many members. You are the body of Christ.
The still more excellent way. Love never ends. The greatest of these is love.
Prophecy and tongues. Let all things be done for building up. God is not a God of confusion.
The gospel I preached: Christ died, was buried, was raised. If Christ has not been raised, your faith is futile.
The collection. Travel plans. Be watchful, stand firm, let all you do be done in love. Maranatha. Grace.
2corinthians: The God of all comfort. We were so utterly burdened we despaired of life. A yes in Christ.
A painful visit, a tearful letter. Forgive. We are the aroma of Christ.
Letters of recommendation. A new covenant. The ministry of the Spirit. Unveiled faces.
This treasure in clay jars. Afflicted, not crushed. The eternal weight of glory.
A tent and a building from God. The ministry of reconciliation. Be reconciled to God.
Now is the acceptable time. Do not be unequally yoked. I will be a father to you.
I rejoice, not because you were grieved, but because you were grieved into repenting.
The collection for the saints. The grace of our Lord: though he was rich, he became poor.
Finish the collection. Whoever sows sparingly will also reap sparingly. God loves a cheerful giver.
I, Paul, myself entreat you. His letters are weighty, but his bodily presence is weak — so they say.
I betrothed you to one husband. Super-apostles. I robbed other churches. Forty lashes minus one.
Caught up to the third heaven. A thorn. My grace is sufficient for you.
I am coming. Examine yourselves. The God of love and peace. The grace of the Lord Jesus, the love of God, the fellowship of the Holy Spirit.
galatians: Paul an apostle, not from men. Astonished. Even if we or an angel preach another gospel — let him be accursed.
Jerusalem. Titus not circumcised. Peter at Antioch: I opposed him to his face. We know that a person is not justified by works of the law.
O foolish Galatians. Abraham believed. The law as guardian. Neither Jew nor Greek.
Heirs. Why go back to weak and worthless elements. My little children, for whom I am again in anguish of childbirth.
For freedom Christ has set us free. Stand firm. Walk by the Spirit. The fruit of the Spirit.
Bear one another’s burdens. A large hand. Far be it from me to boast except in the cross. Grace.
ephesians: Blessed in Christ with every spiritual blessing. Chosen, adopted, redeemed, sealed.
Dead in trespasses. By grace you have been saved. One new humanity. A dwelling place for God.
The mystery revealed. Paul’s prayer: rooted and grounded in love, filled with all the fullness of God.
Walk worthy. One body, one Spirit, one hope, one Lord, one faith, one baptism, one God. Gifts for building up.
Walk in love. Darkness and light. Husbands, wives, Christ and the church.
Children, fathers, slaves, masters. The armour of God. Peace to the brothers and sisters, and love with faith.
philippians: I thank my God in all my remembrance of you. To live is Christ. Let your manner of life be worthy.
The mind of Christ: emptied, obedient, exalted. Work out your salvation. Lights in the world. Timothy, Epaphroditus.
Beware the dogs. I count everything as loss. The upward call. Our citizenship is in heaven.
Euodia and Syntyche. Rejoice. Do not be anxious. Think on these things. Content in any and every circumstance. Grace.
colossians: Faith, love, hope. A hymn: the image of the invisible God. All things hold together in him. Reconciled.
Walk in him. Fullness in Christ. You died and were raised. Let no one disqualify you.
Put to death what is earthly. Put on love. The word of Christ dwelling richly. Households.
Devote yourselves to prayer. Walk in wisdom toward outsiders. Tychicus, Onesimus, fellow workers. Grace.
1thessalonians: Your work of faith, labour of love, steadfastness of hope. You turned from idols to wait for his Son.
Our coming was not in vain. We were gentle among you. You received the word as what it really is.
Timothy sent. We live, if you stand fast in the Lord. Night and day we pray.
This is the will of God: your holiness. A quiet life. Concerning those who are asleep: we will be with the Lord.
The day like a thief. Stay awake. Admonish, encourage, help. Do not quench the Spirit. The God of peace himself.
2thessalonians: Your faith is growing. God considers it just to repay. When the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven.
Do not be quickly shaken. The rebellion, the man of lawlessness. Stand firm. Hold the traditions.
Pray for us. Keep away from the idle. If anyone is not willing to work, let him not eat. The Lord of peace.
1timothy: Charge certain persons not to teach different doctrine. Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am the foremost.
Prayers for all, including kings. One God, one mediator. Men and women in the assembly.
Overseers and deacons. The church of the living God, a pillar and buttress of the truth. The mystery of godliness.
Some will depart from the faith. Train yourself for godliness. Let no one despise you for your youth.
Widows, elders, slaves. Keep these rules without prejudging.
Godliness with contentment. Fight the good fight. Guard the deposit. Grace be with you.
2timothy: Fan into flame the gift. Do not be ashamed. He is able to guard what I have entrusted. Onesiphorus.
Share in suffering as a good soldier. The word is not chained. A worker who need not be ashamed.
In the last days. All Scripture God-breathed. Preach the word. The time of my departure has come.
I have fought the good fight. Come before winter. The cloak, the books. The Lord will rescue me. Grace.
titus: Elders in Crete. Rebuke them sharply. To the pure, all things are pure.
Older men, older women, younger women, younger men, slaves. Grace has appeared, training us.
Be submissive. He saved us according to his mercy. Insist on good works. Avoid foolish controversies. Grace.
philemon: Paul a prisoner. Onesimus, once useless, now useful. Receive him as a beloved brother. Charge it to my account. A guest room. Grace.
hebrews: God has spoken by a Son. Superior to angels. Let all God’s angels worship him.
A great salvation. For a little while lower than the angels. He is not ashamed to call them brothers.
Jesus counted worthy of more glory than Moses. Today, if you hear his voice.
A sabbath rest remains. The word of God, living and active. A great high priest.
Every high priest. Christ did not exalt himself. In the days of his flesh he offered up prayers with loud cries.
Leave the elementary doctrine. Impossible to restore to repentance — a hard word. A sure hope behind the curtain.
Melchizedek. The lesser is blessed by the greater. A priest forever.
The true tent. A better covenant. The old is becoming obsolete.
The earthly sanctuary a copy. Blood. Without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness.
Once for all. A new and living way. Let us draw near. Do not throw away your confidence.
Faith. The elders. Abraham. Moses. A better country. The world was not worthy of them.
Jesus the pioneer and perfecter. Discipline as sons. Mount Zion, not Sinai. A consuming fire.
Brotherly love, marriage, money. Outside the camp. A sacrifice of praise. The God of peace who brought up from the dead our Lord Jesus.
james: Count it joy. Ask for wisdom. The lowly brother, the rich. Be doers. Visit orphans and widows.
No partiality. Faith without works is dead. Abraham. Rahab.
The tongue. Wisdom from above, peaceable, gentle, full of mercy.
Quarrels. Friendship with the world. Draw near to God. Do not speak evil of one another. If the Lord wills.
The rich. Patience until the coming. Elijah prayed. If anyone among you wanders, bring him back.
1peter: Elect exiles. A living hope. Be holy. Love one another earnestly from a pure heart.
A spiritual house. A royal priesthood. Submit to the emperor. Servants, Christ suffered for you.
Wives, husbands. Honour. Do not repay evil. Baptism. Always be prepared to make a defence.
Arm yourselves. Love covers a multitude of sins. The end of all things is at hand. Do not be surprised at the fiery trial.
Shepherd the flock. Humble yourselves. Cast all your anxieties. The God of all grace will restore you. Peace.
2peter: Supplement faith. Make your calling sure. We were eyewitnesses of his majesty. A lamp in a dark place.
False teachers. They promise freedom. The Lord knows how to rescue the godly. A donkey spoke with a human voice.
Scoffers. A thousand years as a day. New heavens and a new earth. Grow in grace. To him be the glory.
1john: That which we have seen and touched. God is light. If we confess our sins.
I am writing so that you may not sin. An advocate. An old commandment. Do not love the world. Antichrists.
See what love the Father has given us. We shall be like him. Practice righteousness. Love in deed and in truth.
Test the spirits. God is love. Perfect love casts out fear. We love because he first loved us.
Faith in the Son. The testimony. I write these things so that you may know. Keep yourselves from idols.
2john: The elect lady. Love one another. Do not receive the deceiver who denies Jesus Christ come in the flesh. Face to face.
3john: Gaius. Fellow workers. Diotrephes loves to be first. Demetrius. Peace. Greet the friends by name.
jude: Contend for the faith. Certain people have crept in. Keep yourselves in the love of God. To him who is able to keep you from stumbling.
revelation: The revelation of Jesus Christ. To the seven churches. One like a son of man among the lampstands.
Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira: first love, tribulation, a white stone, Jezebel.
Sardis, Philadelphia, Laodicea: a name that you live, an open door, lukewarm, I stand at the door and knock.
A door in heaven. A throne. Holy, holy, holy. Twenty-four elders. Lightning and a sea of glass.
A scroll. A Lamb standing as though slain. Worthy is the Lamb. Every creature in heaven and on earth.
Six seals. Four horses. Souls under the altar. The wrath of the Lamb. Who can stand?
144,000 sealed. A multitude no one could count. Salvation belongs to our God and to the Lamb.
The seventh seal. Silence. Seven trumpets. Incense with the prayers of the saints.
Locusts from the pit. A king, Abaddon. Two hundred million cavalry. Still they did not repent.
A mighty angel. A little scroll, sweet and bitter. You must prophesy again.
Two witnesses. A beast from the pit. The seventh trumpet. The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord.
A woman clothed with the sun. A dragon. War in heaven. They have conquered by the blood of the Lamb.
A beast from the sea. A beast from the earth. The number of the beast.
The Lamb on Mount Zion. 144,000. The eternal gospel. Babylon is fallen. The harvest of the earth.
Seven bowls. The song of Moses and the Lamb. The sanctuary opened. It is done — not yet the last time.
Bowls poured. Armageddon. It is done. Hail. The cities of the nations fell.
Babylon the great. A woman on a scarlet beast. The Lamb will conquer.
Fallen, fallen is Babylon. Come out of her, my people. In a single hour.
Rejoice, you saints. The marriage of the Lamb. A rider on a white horse. King of kings.
The dragon bound. A thousand years. Gog and Magog. A great white throne. The dead judged.
A new heaven and a new earth. The holy city. No more death. The one who was seated on the throne: I am making all things new.
The river of life. The tree of life. No more curse. The Spirit and the bride say, come. Amen. Come, Lord Jesus.
